input: Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_g7.text or /moves/pawn_a7.text, the two agents that have gone off plan, must be signed by that agent's own key and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, while also requiring that the ply written to /turn/ply.num is exactly one greater than its current value so a stale or repeated plan cannot be replayed.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/pawn_g7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_g7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_g7.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_g7.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_a7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false))
